oneLine: MICL transfers Marine Lines development rights to Godrej Properties in a Rs 6000-crore deal.

sources.title: MICL transfers Marine Lines development rights to Godrej Properties in ₹6,000-crore revenue deal

synopsis: Man Infraconstruction Limited (MICL), along with Shreepati Group, has transferred the development rights for a sea-facing luxury residential project at Marine Lines in South Mumbai to Godrej Properties in a deal pegged at over ₹6,000 crore in overall revenue potential. MICL, which previously served as the Development Manager, has entered into a revenue-sharing arrangement and will fully recoup its investment of over ₹300 crore. Managing Director Manan Shah noted that the arrangement provides MICL with early cash realization and financial flexibility. The approximately 2.5-acre project will be jointly branded by both parties.
